d:
When emotions run deep, some melodies say what words cannot. Listen to “Woh Meri Neend Mera Chain” from the 1993 Bollywood film Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke, featuring Aamir Khan and Juhi Chawla. Beautifully sung by Sadhana Sargam, this memorable 90s melody brings together heartfelt emotions and the nostalgic charm of classic Hindi film music.
